interface.longDescription: Landfillom by Agel AI is a management platform for landfills and waste facilities in Greece. Connect an existing Landfillom account to work with the facilities you are authorized for: weighings, operational and compliance statistics, HMA (Greek Electronic Waste Registry) reports, partners, documents, staff and maintenance records, and scheduled report deliveries. The assistant only sees the facilities granted to your account. Write actions show a preview and ask for your explicit confirmation before anything is saved or sent. Generated files are delivered as expiring download links.
